meanings.gt_sql:
WITH dept_counts AS (
    SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_ID,
           d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
           COUNT(e.EMPLOYEE_ID) AS emp_cnt,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.SALARY), 0) AS total_salary_expense
    FROM departments d
    LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.DEPARTMENT_ID = e.DEPARTMENT_ID
    GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_ID, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
avg_cnt AS (
    SELECT AVG(emp_cnt) AS avg_emp_cnt FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       total_salary_expense
FROM dept_counts
CROSS JOIN avg_cnt
WHERE emp_cnt > avg_emp_cnt;
